root_cause.text: The `swap_space` address space structure was incorrectly marked as read-only after initialization (`__ro_after_init`), preventing necessary runtime writes to its error sequence fields during memory reclamation and causing a page fault.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the `swap_space` attribute from `__ro_after_init` to `__read_mostly` in `mm/swap.h` and `mm/swap_state.c`, and the stack trace shows a page fault in `errseq_set` triggered by write attempts to the read-only swap address space.
